noun_definition: web chat refers to the messaging interface within the app where users can send and receive messages in real-time.
copy refers to the action of duplicating text or a link from a chat message to the clipboard or marking the message as unread, which should also refocus the message composer in the application.
Clipboard refers to the temporary storage area in the application where copied text or links are held after selecting the "Copy to clipboard" option from the context menu.
Link refers to an option in the Mini context menu that, when selected, is expected to copy the URL of the chat message to the clipboard.
mark refers to an option in the Mini context menu that allows users to indicate a message as unread in the chat application.
unread refers to a status option in the chat application that allows users to mark a message as not yet read, indicating that it requires attention.
Mini context menu refers to a small pop-up menu that appears when hovering over a message in the chat, providing options such as Copy to clipboard, Copy link, and Mark as unread.
composer refers to the input area in the chat application where users type their messages.
